data.title: Harmony Proposes Mainnet Shutdown, ONE Migration to Ethereum, and AI Video Business Shift
data.description:
Harmony has proposed two non-binding plans to shut down its mainnet, migrate the native ONE token to Ethereum, and shift into an AI video remix business. According to PANews, the team said threats from state-level attackers and AI agents were the reasons for proposing the network shutdown.

The migration plan would take a snapshot at the network's final block of user wallets, staking delegations, validator rewards, smart contracts, and tokens held on centralized exchanges. New ONE would be airdropped on Ethereum to the same wallet addresses without requiring holders to claim it, while delegated staking and unclaimed rewards would be airdropped to the respective governance treasuries. The total ONE supply and issuance rate would remain unchanged, and newly issued tokens would be used for the new business.

Harmony said multisig wallets, liquidity pools, and on-chain applications cannot migrate, and urged users to exit all smart contracts by September 10, 2026. The team also plans to publish the token contract, snapshot calculations, and airdrop scripts for audit. Validators can stop running nodes starting at 22:00 (UTC+8) on September 10.

The team plans to compensate the difference in issuance rewards between node shutdown and the network's final block, and has set aside a one-time compensation pool of $1.372 million. Payments would be made over four quarters to validators and delegators who stop on time, sign the agreement, keep their stake, and serve as governors for the new project.

The new business would allow users to remix prompts and materials, with AI agents expanding video stories. Harmony also plans to recruit operators for video generation, distribution, and content review. In the first year, the company plans to subsidize GPU hardware and support video generation demand, while operators would stake tokens and earn rewards based on service uptime. The team said operators could generate up to $1 million in combined first-year revenue if staking and uptime requirements are met, and promoters could receive a 30% ongoing commission from their referrals' monthly $10 subscriptions.

data.title: PPP Monitoring Shows Loss-Making Account Bought MOUZ Win Prediction in CS2 Blast Final
data.description:
PPP monitoring showed that an account with nearly $200,000 in losses bought a MOUZ win prediction for the CS2 Blast final against Spirit. According to Odaily, the wallet address 0x7c37b52eb226bcb9411375ec48b0169663fb6aeb opened the position at an average price of 36.4 cents and bought 786,825.9 shares.

The match began at 22:00 on September 6 and was played as a best-of-five series. Spirit was described as a top team, while MOUZ reached the final after a 2-0 semifinal win over Team Vitality.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Haley Stevens Says Canadian Tariffs Are Raising Costs in Michigan
data.description:
Michigan Representative Haley Stevens said escalating US tariffs on Canadian goods are raising costs and creating uncertainty for manufacturers in her district, with the auto supply chain especially exposed, according to Bloomberg.

She told Bloomberg This Weekend hosts Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason that she is promoting legislation to provide households with as much as $1,700 to offset tariff-related costs, while criticizing the Trump administration’s trade approach with Canada.

data.title: BOC Fund Names Chen Weixing Executive President
data.description:
BOC Fund said on September 5 that former chief inspector and deputy executive president Chen Weixing has been appointed executive president, effective September 4. After stepping down from his previous roles, the chief inspector post remains vacant and Chen will continue to act in that capacity, according to Jiemian News.

The move follows the departure of former executive president Zhang Jiawen on August 10, when he left for a planned role as executive president of BOC Investment (Hong Kong). Chen joined BOC Fund in 2022. Public records show he previously worked at Bank of China headquarters and branches in several senior roles.

Jiemian News also reported that BOC Fund’s management has been updated again after Liu Xinqun formally became chairman and legal representative on December 11, 2025. Wind data showed the firm’s public fund assets under management reached 731.716 billion yuan at the end of the second quarter of 2026, a record high. Of that, money market funds accounted for 453.503 billion yuan, non-money market funds for 278.112 billion yuan, bond funds for 233.361 billion yuan, hybrid funds for 21.993 billion yuan and equity funds for 9.048 billion yuan.

As of the end of the second quarter, BOC Fund managed 334 public funds, with 145 products above 200 million yuan each and 11 funds above 10 billion yuan each. It had 113 active equity funds, including 59 so-called mini funds with less than 50 million yuan each. Jiemian News reported that the firm launched 14 funds so far this year, including four active hybrid funds with initial sizes of 66 million yuan, 10 million yuan, 16 million yuan and 15 million yuan.

data.title: Arbitrum Co-Founder Warns Against Comparing On-Chain Trading Costs by Fees Alone
data.description:
Arbitrum co-founder Steven Goldfeder said traders should not fall into the "narrative trap" of comparing on-chain trading costs by fees alone. According to Odaily, he said Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain both actively prevent harmful MEV such as frontrunning, while some chains that advertise low fees may carry higher MEV costs, leaving retail users with extra losses from frontrunning and sandwich trades.

Solana co-founder Toly responded that Arbitrum currently has wider bid-ask spreads and higher fees, and that the cost implied by a 10% cut of fees alone is already higher than sandwich-trade rates. He added that if worse spreads are included, total costs are about 10 times higher by his estimate, and said a single-sequencer model that seeks to maximize shareholder利益 can never beat permissionless market competition.

data.title: Polymarket Arsenal-Chelsea Submarket Over Odds Jump to 65.5%

data.title: Rescuers Race To Free People Trapped After Delhi Building Collapse
data.description:
According to the BBC, a residential building in Delhi collapsed on Sunday, leaving dozens of students feared trapped inside and killing at least one person. NDTV, citing local police, said two others were in critical condition and six people had been rescued so far.

Eyewitnesses told local media that as many as 50 people were inside the five-storey Hostel Daze building in south-west Delhi's Satya Niketan neighbourhood when it came down around 13:30 local time (08:00 GMT). Construction work had been taking place in the basement, and many of the students staying there were believed to be in their rooms because there were no lessons on Sunday. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta said an adjacent building had been evacuated as a precaution, while police said the building was 40 or 50 years old. The National Students' Union of India called for an investigation into the collapse and for anyone responsible to be held to account.

data.title: STOCKS | Beijing Zhongke Wenge H-Share Added To Southbound Stock Connect List
data.description:
Beijing Zhongke Wenge (1956) said its H shares have been included in the eligible securities list for Southbound Stock Connect, effective from tomorrow (7), allowing qualified mainland China investors to trade the H shares directly through the scheme, according to Ming Pao.

The company said the move is expected to broaden its investor base further and may improve trading liquidity in the H shares.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | USS Abraham Lincoln Crew Describes Strain of 286-Day Deployment
data.description:
The USS Abraham Lincoln crew got a long-awaited port visit in Thailand after a 286-day deployment that included a modern-era record 264 consecutive days at sea and months of combat operations in the Middle East, according to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg News Southeast Asia reporter Philip Heijmans, who recently returned from Thailand, said sailors described food shortages, limited communication with family and uncertainty about when they would return, while many also said they were proud of their mission.

data.title: Real Bedford Aims to Become a Global Bitcoin Brand
data.description:
Real Bedford, a small English football club, is aiming to become a global Bitcoin brand. According to ChainCatcher, the club was acquired by podcast host Peter McCormack in 2022 and has attracted fans worldwide after raising $4.5 million from Cameron Winklevoss and Tyler Winklevoss.

The club allows fans to use Bitcoin to buy tickets, food, and merchandise. Some players and staff are paid partly or entirely in Bitcoin. Its long-term goals are to reach the English Football League, build a new stadium and youth academy, and show that the global Bitcoin community can help transform a local club.

data.title: STONK Market Cap Tops $150 Million as Solana Meme Token Gains Over 430%
data.description:
STONK on Solana briefly topped a market capitalization of $150 million and was last reported at $136 million, up more than 430% over the past 24 hours. According to Odaily, Stonk lets users issue meme tokens and pair them with tokenized real-world assets, including tokenized stocks and pre-IPO stock tokens.

Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko previously reposted Stonk-related messages and asked, "What is Stonk Token?"

data.title: Vitalik Buterin Says Poseidon Hash Functions Have Delivered Practical Value for Ethereum
data.description:
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said the Poseidon hash function family, developed over several years, has already delivered significant practical value on Ethereum and in other areas and will continue to do so in the coming years. According to Odaily, he said modern privacy protocols can quickly generate SNARK proofs on the client side, and Poseidon is one of the key reasons for that.

Buterin also said general-purpose STARKs have now reached very high performance, with proof costs for nearly any batch computation reduced to the low hundreds. He added that these costs could fall further to the low tens or even lower, a development that has exceeded early-2020s expectations.

data.title: Oil Prices Rise As Much As 1.5% After OPEC+ Reaffirms Output Pause Plan
data.description:
According to CNBC, oil prices rose as much as 1.5% on Monday after OPEC+ members reaffirmed a plan to pause production increases in the first quarter of next year. OPEC+ kept its oil output policy unchanged for October at a meeting on Sunday, saying the producer group still needs to agree on new quotas before deciding its next output steps.

The meeting included seven core OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — as the Iran war continues to disrupt oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz. OPEC+ agreed in August to a production boost for September, completing a phased rollback of a 1.65 million-barrel-per-day supply cut first agreed in 2023. Brent crude futures gained 76 cents to close at $96.28 a barrel on Friday, while West Texas Intermediate crude futures advanced 18 cents to settle at $91.48.

data.title: US President Donald Trump Says Canadian Dollar Imbalance Against the U.S. Dollar Is Unacceptable
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Truth Social that the Canadian dollar’s imbalance against the U.S. dollar is unacceptable. According to Sina Finance, he added that the situation has lasted for many years but will not continue.

data.title: US Pushes to Raise Missile Interceptor Production
data.description:
The US still has significant munitions capacity for operations against Iran, but stocks of advanced interceptor missiles are under greater strain, according to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Defense Analyst Col. Wayne Sanders told Christina Ruffini and Jeff Mason on Bloomberg This Weekend that manufacturers are being pressed to sharply increase output, with sprawling supply chains and concerns about preserving advanced weapons for other potential conflicts complicating the effort.

data.title: Polymarket LoL Playoff Market Sees Sharp Swing in Ninjas in Pyjamas Odds
data.description: Polymarket’s "Game 4 Winner" submarket for the "LoL: Ninjas in Pyjamas vs LGD Gaming - LPL Playoffs" event saw the probability for Ninjas in Pyjamas jump from 57% one hour earlier to 73.5%, a 16.5 percentage-point move. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp change was flagged by Catcher Predict monitoring, which noted that related breaking news may have affected the market.

data.title: Willy Woo Says Bitcoin Is Decoupling From U.S. Stocks Again
data.description: Crypto analyst Willy Woo said Bitcoin is significantly decoupling from U.S. equities, adding that the last time the gap was this pronounced was in 2015, before the 2017 Bitcoin bull market. According to ChainCatcher, Woo compared the current setup with 2014 to 2017, when stocks were still in a bull market in 2014, weakened for two straight years in 2015 and 2016, and then turned bullish again in 2017 as Bitcoin extended its rally. Woo said the current market structure looks similar, with Bitcoin liquidity continuing to strengthen while stocks are beginning to show signs of fragility.

data.title: STOCKS | BlackRock, JPMorgan Funds Find Edge in Emerging Markets
data.description:
Funds run by JPMorgan Asset Management and BlackRock Inc. have found an edge in emerging markets as government bonds from major economies buckle, according to Bloomberg.

The move comes as turmoil grips global bond markets.

data.title: STOCKS | CITIC Securities Says Market Remains Range-Bound, Urges Calm on Overseas Rates
data.description: According to Jin10, CITIC Securities said whether the Federal Reserve raises rates in September is not enough to determine the direction of long-term interest rates or equities, and that the market is currently still mainly range-bound.
